title: Business Security Deposit Recalculation and Raised Requirement
content:
A held business Security Deposit is recalculated at the recalculation interval of its kind after its fully secured date, and its recalculated requirement is worked out on the recalculation date.

**Condition on interest credits.** The recalculated requirement is not fixed until the deposit carries an interest credit for every anniversary of its fully secured date reached so far.

Stated the other way: while any anniversary of the fully secured date reached by the recalculation date has no interest credit on the deposit whose period ends on that anniversary, the recalculated requirement is not fixed.

| Anniversaries of the fully secured date reached so far | Interest credits on the deposit with those period ends | Recalculated requirement fixed? |
|---|---|---|
| Two | Both | Yes |
| Two | Only the first | No |
| One | None | No |

## Recording a raised requirement: `require_additional_deposit_b541b477`

**Capability.** The tool records a raised requirement on a held business Security Deposit, returning the deposit to assessed status with the new required amount. The deposit's required amount and the average monthly bill behind it are replaced by the stated values, the date the additional amount falls due is recorded, the deposit's status becomes assessed, and today becomes both its assessment date and its status date. The cash already held stays on the deposit. The new requirement and due date show on the deposit at once.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `deposit_id` | The deposit reference number of the held deposit whose requirement is raised, as returned by the security-deposit lookup for the customer | Reference number |
| `required_amount` | The new required deposit amount | USD with 2 decimal places, a whole-dollar amount written with .00 cents |
| `average_monthly_bill` | The average monthly bill the new requirement rests on | USD with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |
| `due_date` | The date by which the additional amount is due | YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date with no time of day |

**Return.** A one-line text receipt naming the deposit, its new required amount and average monthly bill in USD with 2 decimal places, its status (assessed) and the due date; the assessed status in the receipt confirms the raised requirement was recorded.
